description: A finite-arity partial function \(f\) is partial recursive if and only if a paired program \(c\) satisfies \(\llbracket c\rrbracket(E_n(\bar x))\simeq f(\bar x)\) for every input tuple.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.finite_arity_program_iff {n : ℕ}
  {f : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.PFunction n} :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Recursive f ↔
    ∃ c,
      ∀ (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args n),
        c.eval (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.tuplePack v) = f v
